critical_code_review_comments: WaterPanel: potential race condition — if user clicks btn-water-plus before GET /water promise resolves, local state (0) overwrites server state via POST. Minor; consider disabling buttons until initial fetch completes or using functional setState with latest server value.
MealPlanViewer.enableReminders uses setInterval 20s + Notification API; works but polling-based. Notifications are denied in headless as expected and gracefully fall back to toast — no error.
